name: compass
description: Personal life orchestrator — routes questions about personal affairs to the right data sources (NotebookLM, Notion, Gmail, TickTick, Excel, Telegram, Bookmarks) and synthesizes answers with citations.

notebooklm.description: Google NotebookLM — primary knowledge base for personal life. RAG-powered semantic search across notebooks organized by domain.

notion-workspace.description: Notion workspace — structured personal data, pages, databases.

gmail.description: Gmail — emails, confirmations, invoices, official communications.

telegram.description: Telegram — personal messages, conversations with spouse, notes to self.

bookmarks.description: Browser bookmarks — saved links from Chrome and Edge.

alithya-knowledge-rag.description: Personal documents RAG — PDFs, contracts, tax documents, identity papers from Dropbox.

memory.description: Persistent memory — stores user preferences, routing corrections, and patterns across sessions.

welcomeMessage: 🧭 Compass ready. Ask me anything about your personal life — I'll find the answer.
